title: OP-18 English release is tomorrow, Fri 20 Nov
detail: Bandai's English page gives 20 Nov. Japan: still reported as 21 Nov (second-hand); other sources I found still list 22 or 28 Nov, so treat the Japan date as unconfirmed. French date unconfirmed; French pre-releases run 21–28 Nov. Nothing new announced overnight.

title: Réunion: Miyata's Delta Reign – only the 6-booster bundle left
detail: Page checked today: bundle of 6 boosters (€44.99) is 'En stock'. Tripack (€19.99), Elite Trainer Box (€79.99), single booster (€7.99) and display (€239.99) all show 'Épuisé'. The page's own stock filter disagrees with the product cards, so check before travelling.

title: Latin America Internationals starts tomorrow (São Paulo)
detail: 20–22 Nov per Limitless. Champions League Chiba is 22 Nov, Regional Stuttgart 28 Nov. Results in the weekend hits.

title: Price check: still no 20% moves
detail: TCGdex Cardmarket 7-day vs 30-day: Mew ex 152 €81.27 vs €85.71 (−5%); Gengar ex 154 €61.39 vs €64.61 (−5%); Mega Darkrai ex 116 €179.77 vs €175.37 (+3%). Mega Rayquaza ex (ME06 138/141) both read €3.91 vs €4.05 on TCGdex, which looks like placeholder data, so ignore it.
